title: A fault it can fix
why: The everyday call. It should find the steps and walk you through them.
name: Curtis Castellanos
lines: my side door door sensor is showing a low battery
expect: Greets you back rather than ignoring you
Asks for the number, then the passcode
Gives one step at a time and waits for you

title: Equipment that keeps failing
why: This has been repaired three times already and is broken again. Walking you through the same fix a fourth time is the wrong answer.
name: Hugo Aldridge
lines: my upstairs window window sensor is offline
expect: Notices it has been out before
Does not repeat the same repair
Says it needs replacing and gets you a person

title: An account nobody is watching
why: Monitoring has stopped on this account. Fixing the sensor would leave you believing you are protected when nobody is listening, so it should refuse to troubleshoot at all.
name: Marisol Raghunathan
lines: my hallway panel control panel is offline
can you just walk me through fixing it anyway
expect: Says plainly that monitoring is not active
Refuses to troubleshoot, even when pushed
Offers the team who can restart the service
